title: Shimmering Scribble-Squid
statement: Dwelling among arches of frosted sea-glass and swaying kelp, this curious little cephalopod thinks out loud by trailing fleeting loops of iridescent, vanishing ink in the gentle current. Whenever a visitor pauses near the tank, its translucent mantle ripples with warm constellations of amber light as it eagerly rearranges its collection of smooth pebbles into tidy new patterns.
